about: Electric-vehicle chargers in Accra that their operators or the press document but that neither OpenStreetMap nor Overture maps (the Ghana extract of 17 Nov 2026 has one amenity=charging_station in Accra, outside the game's areas; Overture 2026-10-21.0 has none). Each stands only at a host that OpenStreetMap maps: the fuel station or the car park its sources name, by its OpenStreetMap id, so no position is guessed. scripts/ev_chargers.py reads this file (build_district.py --ev-documented); a charger OpenStreetMap or Overture maps within 60 m of the host replaces its entry. Unknown fields are left out, not guessed. To check on the ground, as the brands are cleared, before a public release.

chargers.note: A Level 2 unit of about 22 kW at the Liberation Road branch of TotalEnergies (the host is OpenStreetMap's 'Liberation Road TotalEnergies'), commissioned in September 2022, the first at a service station in Ghana; how many cars at once and which connector are not stated.

POBAD's chargers at the A&C Mall, East Legon (CleanTechnica, December 2020: DC fast chargers supporting CCS, CHAdeMO and GB/T, and slow AC chargers, not said which stand at which mall); circle-reference obs-accra-ev-seagull-001 (Yen, August 2026) names chargers in 'the A&C Mall area'. The host is the mall's car park as OpenStreetMap maps it ('A & C Mall', amenity=parking).
